note: Learning & Knowledge → Code of Conduct. The versions an employee can acknowledge, newest first by `effective_from`. A revision is a NEW entry (law 3): an acknowledgement records the version it was given against, so an old acknowledgement never counts for a new text. The `current` version is the newest whose `effective_from` is not in the future.

sections.heading: Integrity
sections.text: Act honestly in every dealing with borrowers, colleagues, clients and regulators. Never misrepresent an amount, a date or an authority.

sections.heading: Fair practice
sections.text: Follow the fair practices code in every contact: identify yourself, contact only at permitted hours, no harassment, no intimidation, no visits to a workplace without consent.

sections.heading: Confidentiality
sections.text: Borrower and company data is used only for the work assigned and never copied, shared or retained beyond it.

sections.heading: Conflicts of interest
sections.text: Declare any relationship with a borrower, vendor or client before acting on the account.

sections.heading: Reporting
sections.text: Report a breach, a suspected breach or pressure to breach to HR or the compliance officer. Retaliation against a reporter is itself a breach.

statement: I have read and understood the Code of Conduct above and agree to abide by it.
